propositions: The inbound_fields.py mapper must remain at the package root to preserve the J7 sibling-adapter seal between jira and jira_datacenter, since Data Center intentionally delegates to the same mapper as Cloud.

The neutrality-sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py exists as a permanent architectural cost, not temporary relocation debt, and must be reworded to explain the sealed-adapter rationale instead of claiming future move.

Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 contract by allowing jira_datacenter to import a sibling adapter package; moving to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot consume that layer.
The module's by-path load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be routed through jira_family without laundering the AST gate, since _FORBIDDEN_IN_FAMILY bans that dependency by name for imports.
Operator decision E (option retained, not moved) requires updating test_backend_neutrality.py comments, docstrings, and diagnostics to document the durable J7 seal reason for the exemption.
